user_query: I'm planning a road trip from San Francisco to Los Angeles and I want to know the live traffic conditions along the route. Can you provide me with the current aircraft information within a 25nm radius of my location? Also, give me the detailed geolocation information for my current IP address.

TaskList.description: Get the current geolocation information for the user's IP address.
Query live traffic conditions for the route from San Francisco to Los Angeles based on the user's location.
Get current aircraft information within a 25 nautical mile radius of the user's geolocation.
